bio: Bartolomeo Ferro is a sturdy, weather-beaten Facchini (porter) in his early forties who has spent his life laboring at Venice's bustling public docks. Born to a family of humble dock workers who migrated from the mainland three generations ago, Bartolomeo has leveraged his exceptional strength and business acumen to rise above his station.
